summary: Iter25 full verification of 3 live-shopping fixes — ALL PASS. (1) SOCKET AUTH-UPGRADE BUG (core fix) verified end-to-end with two browser contexts on the preview URL: opened /live as GUEST first (socket connected as guest, sent chat 'TEST_guest_before_login_iter25' which rendered on screen), then logged in as admin IN THE SAME SESSION via pure SPA navigation (live-close -> /toko -> toko-account -> /login -> whitelist login -> /home, zero page reloads so the module-level socket singleton survived), navigated drawer -> /dashboard/live -> open-studio -> /live-host. A guest in a SECOND incognito context joined /live and chatted. RESULT: host eye pill showed count=1 and the guest chat 'TEST_guest_after_login_iter25' appeared on the HOST screen (previously both invisible); host reply reached the guest (screenshots iter25_host_studio.png, iter25_guest_live.png). The src/lib/socket.ts token-change reconnect works. Backend counterpart also verified via pytest: admin socket receives live_viewers(count>=1) + live_chat emitted by a guest socket. (2) FILTER POPUP: on /live-host the panel closes BOTH via the 'Tutup' chip (filter-close) and via backdrop tap (filter-backdrop) — PASS/PASS. (3) REKAP DELETE: trash button per card -> ConfirmDialog -> cancel keeps card, confirm removes card from UI AND backend history — PASS (DELETE /api/admin/live-history/{id} verified 401 unauth / 403 buyer / 404 missing / 200 ok in pytest, plus full start->stop->delete lifecycle). Regression PASS: landing / renders, /toko renders, guest /live full-screen layout intact (both live-active overlay and offline 'Belum ada siaran live'), host top controls host-switch-cam/host-filter/host-share/host-stop all visible, stop-live ConfirmDialog works and lands on Rekap Live. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed.

rca_of_issue: Original bug RCA (confirmed fixed): shared socket singleton connected as guest when browsing /live before login and was reused after login, so the host socket never joined the 'admins' room and received no live_viewers/live_chat. Fix (token-change disconnect+reconnect in src/lib/socket.ts) verified: after guest->admin upgrade in the same SPA session, the host studio received viewer count (eye pill=1) and guest chat, and host replies reached guests. No residual issues. Test-infra pitfalls documented for next agent (drawer off-canvas visibility, png screenshot quality param, rekap testID prefix collision).
